text: The account holder is Hina Yousaf with account number PK**HABB****7792, opened on 4 December 2020. The subject declares a student occupation and a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 May 2026 and 11 May 2026, the account received 19 credits totalling PKR 979,000 and made 4 debits totalling PKR 850,000. All 19 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 15 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 11 May 2026, scoring a Tazama typology MULE-01 of 360 against a threshold of 300. The presence of 15 distinct inbound senders in a short period is consistent with the red flag of many unrelated inbound senders. The fact that 87% of credits were debited within a median of 9.6 hours suggests most inbound value leaves the account within hours. The credits in the activity window were 39.2 times the declared monthly income, indicating activity inconsistent with the subject's declared student profile. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected money mule activity. PKR 572,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 278,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. Screening on 29 May 2026 found no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media lists. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
